knownGaps: Fade-frame slideshow image array is in inline JS in the canonical capture; mainslide images were not separately archived, so the slideshow renders empty until those URLs land via closest-CDX.

Custom Knockout-HTF28-JuniorFeatherwt display font used by `.fontface_K` was never successfully archived (all Wayback captures return HTTP 500); it falls back to the Helvetica stack. KlavikaBold and KlavikaRegularPlain were recovered from Wayback and are served from /shared-assets/2011/fonts/.

Facebook fan-box (fb:fan) widget in the green footer column is deprecated; replaced with a static Facebook Like-style card. StatCounter and the live Tumblr feed are similarly replaced with static links.

Vimeo 2011 lineup video (id 20397258, 'FREE PRESS SUMMERFEST 2011 LINE-UP' by Free Video Houston) is domain-restricted and player.vimeo.com returns HTTP 401; iframe embed replaced with an oEmbed poster that click-throughs to vimeo.com/20397258.
Twitter feed iframe (feed.php) is gone; the FROM TWITTER box renders a single @fpsummerfest link instead of the live tweet list.
Bunny mascot originally animated via jsAnim.positionCircle counter-clockwise; approximated with a CSS keyframe orbit so we don't ship jQuery 1.2.6 + jsAnim.
Hover-state images for pass/hotel/shirt buttons exist in shared-assets but the original rollover behavior used jsAnim; current implementation renders the static state only.
Sub-pages (pass, lineup, info, faq, sponsors, vendors, press, contact) are not yet rebuilt; nav links are stubs.
